svg.title: Moving buckets, not keys
svg.desc: An animation in four steps. Twenty players of an online game, listed by tag with the hash of their player id, hash into 16 buckets with hash(player_id) mod 16. A map then gives database servers db-0, db-1, db-2, and db-3 a run of four buckets each. Server db-4 joins and takes buckets 3, 7, 11, and 15, one from each server. Each bucket moves with the players inside it, and its map entry changes to db-4 once it arrives. A lookup for Adder, whose player id hashes to 47, still computes bucket 15 and now reads db-4 from the map. Only Coyote, Newt, Gibbon, Quail, and Adder changed server, 5 of the 20 players, and no player was rehashed.
svg.text: A player's bucket never changes. Adding a server edits the map and moves whole buckets.

g.text: map[15] was db-3 until db-4 joined

svg.text: Players hash into 16 buckets with hash(player_id) mod 16. There are always 16 buckets, so a player's bucket never changes.
A map assigns buckets to servers. Each of the four servers gets four buckets.
Server db-4 joins and takes one bucket from each server. The players inside move with their bucket.
Lookups read the new map. Only the players in buckets 3, 7, 11, and 15 moved: 5 of 20.
